segments.title: Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers top-of-hour sign-on; Hype Train interrupts with prostate-themed freestyle; Daniel introduced as new intern; Kendelle brief walk-through.

segments.title: News Desk: JD Vance, Ice Cream Shop, Pikachu ISS Tour
segments.notes: Case and Liliana review bin lore wiki; JD Vance clip on livestreamed execution; Massachusetts ice cream shop viral post; Pikachu ISS tour triggers Chet Guy the Science Eyes.

segments.title: Chet Interrupts: Pikachu Biology & Space Reproduction
segments.notes: Chet commandeers broadcast after 'science' spoken; analyzes Pikachu reproduction, adult Pichu existence, and space colony logistics.

segments.title: Double Debate: Something vs Nothing & Tell HateSock
segments.notes: Skeleton Munch and Crum debate two topics: something vs nothing (nothing wins), and whether to inform HateSock of Kendall's engagement (lies win).

segments.title: Abs Tutorial, Being Normal, Breathing Exercises
segments.notes: Jeb demonstrates lower-ab flexing technique, attempts 'how to be normal' steps, and tries guided breathing faces with ghost dad commentary.

segments.title: Joe Rogan Parody: Birthing Fluid, Trap-Max Workforce, Blug Streaming
segments.notes: Dual Joe Rogans field chat questions on mind-worm elixirs, birthing fluid sourcing, trap-max labor, and Paramount/Disney merger into 'Blug'.

segments.title: Park Interviews: Shape-Shifters, Alien Grey, Skeleton Sheriff
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein interviews park visitors including shape-shifting Aion/Rob, undercover Mountain Man Mike, gelatinous park sheriff skeleton, and yanking singularity theorist.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Raid Prep
segments.notes: Case wraps broadcast, confirms Daniel's son Orval Reddenbacher, mentions Fiona project launch next week, Pepito raids Raz.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: lead anchor. Anchored news desk, moderated Munch & Crum debates, hosted Jo Rogen Experience, closed show with project update.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train host. Derailed sign-on with prostate-themed freestyle rap, sparred with Daniel intern, demanded genre shifts.

characters.name: Daniel
characters.notes: Introduced as new Pepito intern; debated prostate health, revealed son named Orval Reddenbacher, offered to cover streams.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Brief studio walk-through for equipment; engagement confirmed via wiki and debated on air.

characters.name: Liliana
characters.notes: desk partner. Co-anchored news desk, read ice cream shop story, reacted to wiki entries, challenged JD Vance bit.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debated something vs nothing and HateSock disclosure; claimed full head of hair in flesh form, denied therapy obligation.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: debate analyst. Appeared as immortal skeleton; argued for nothingness and lying to HateSock; admitted dying and returning from hell.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: instructional host. Hosted How To with Jeb: abs flexing, normalcy tutorial, breathing exercises; bickered with ghost dad in wood.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: field correspondent. Conducted park interviews from bushes; encountered shape-shifters, alien grey, skeleton sheriff, yanking theorist.

characters.name: Chet
characters.notes: science correspondent. Triggered by 'science' during Pikachu video; delivered breakdown on Pikachu reproduction and space colony biology.

[22:32] Wiki confirms Kendall engaged; [45:58] Munch & Crum debate whether to tell HateSock; lies faction wins.

Case Blackwell working on launch project with Fiona targeting week of 2026-10-20.
Trip Bradstein's park sheriff is a gelatinous human-form skeleton active at 3-4pm with 60% humidity.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News navigated a segment-dense broadcast featuring a dual Munch & Crum debate while Munch remains in permanent skeleton form, a Chet Guy the Science Eyes interruption on Pikachu reproductive biology, and a Trip on the Street edition plagued by shape-shifting park visitors. The network's bin lore wiki was reviewed live, confirming Kendall's engagement and sparking a debate on whether to inform the HateSock. Executive producer Pepito closed the night with a raid on Raz after Case noted an upcoming project launch with Fiona.
